Return approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) associated with infection-related indications. Select molecule chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID (indication_curie), indication label (indication_label), and max_phase_for_ind. Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading contains 'infection'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind ascending.
